items.note: Stated as 'increased from 52% to 72.8%'. Same page also states '72% of births are attended to by skilled health personnel'. No year or data source given. Not comparable with KDHS.
'86% of children are fully immunized'. No year, age group or data source given (likely KHIS administrative data, but not stated).

khis.publicNoLogin: not confirmed; evidence says login required
evidence: Direct requests from this environment to hiskenya.org (/, /api/me, /api/system/info, /dhis-web-commons/security/login.action) were reset by the remote end on 2026-10-24; the site could not be reached at all, so no public endpoint could be tested.
WebFetch refused hiskenya.org: robots.txt disallows automated access.
PLOS Global Public Health 2021 (doi 10.1371/journal.pgph.0000029), data availability statement: 'Aggregated DHIS2 data is available online with access provided by Ministry of Health'.
KHIS is a DHIS2 instance; DHIS2 data and API endpoints require an authenticated user unless the operator publishes public dashboards, and no public dashboard or open-data export for KHIS was found.

gaps: No outpatient (OPD) visit figures for Nyamira found in any official public document; these exist mainly in KHIS (login).
No facility-level or sub-county immunisation, ANC or delivery figures found publicly.
KDHS 2022 county estimates rest on small samples (55 women, 57 births, 24 children aged 12-23 months); vaccination figures are flagged in the report as based on 25-49 unweighted cases.
Nyamira ADP 2026/27 gives activity counts, not coverage rates; CIDP 2023-27 coverage figures lack year and source.
